Wake up to the sight of endless blue and the sound of gentle waves just beyond your window. The Sea View Double Room at Azure is designed for couples or solo travelers who crave simplicity, comfort, and a direct sea connection.

This bright, open-plan space is infused with natural light and dressed in soft, boho-inspired tones — from sun-bleached wood textures to flowing linen curtains that catch the breeze. Step onto your private balcony to sip your morning coffee as the Aegean unfolds before you.

Inside, you’ll find everything you need for a restful stay: a plush queen-size bed, curated details, and calming décor that mirrors the landscape outside. Whether you're here to explore Crete or to do absolutely nothing, this room offers the perfect place to retreat, recharge, and soak in the rhythm of island life.

items.item_title: What time is check-in and check-out?
Are pets allowed at the resort?
How do I make a reservation?

settings.editor: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, and check-out is available until 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged in advance, subject to availability. Our team will gladly assist with luggage storage or offer access to common areas if you arrive early or depart later in the day.

Yes, small pets are welcome in select rooms and villas upon request. A small cleaning fee applies per stay. We kindly ask that pets are not brought into the restaurant, spa, or pool areas, ensuring comfort for all our guests.

You can book directly through our official website for the best available rates and exclusive offers. Reservations can also be made by email or phone, and our team will be happy to assist with personalized recommendations or special requests.
